Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXV OF 2002
SALES TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXV OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
7th June, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated 7-6-2002.-- The following Ordinance
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Sales Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 6, Sales Tax Act, 1990

ORDINANCE XXV OF 2002
SALES TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXV OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
7th June, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated 7-6-2002.-- The following Ordinance
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 6, Sales Tax Act, 1990.--In the Sales Tax
Act, 1990, in section 6, after subsection (1), the following new subsection
shall be inserted and shall be deemed to have always been so added, namely:--
"(1A) Notwithstanding
anything contained in any other law for the tie being in force, including but
not limited to the Protection of Economic Reforms Act, 1992 (XII of 1992), and
notwithstanding any decision or judgment of any forum, authority or Court,
whether passed, before or after promulgation of the Finance Act, 1998 (III of
1998), the provisions of section 31-A of the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969),
referred to in subsection (1) shall be incorporated in and shall be deemed to
have always been so incorporated in this Act and no person shall be entitled to
any exemption from the adjustment of or refund of tax on account of absence of
such a provision in. this Act, or in consequence of any decision or judgment of
any forum, authority or Court passed on that ground or on the, basis of the
doctrine of promissory estoppel or on account of any promise or commitment made
or understanding given whether in writing or otherwise by any Government
Department or authority."
